description: Each weekday morning: the threads still waiting on a reply, with a short nudge drafted for each.
instructions_md: Look through my sent mail for threads where I asked for something or was promised an answer, and nobody has replied for {{days}} days or more. List each one, oldest first: who it's to, the subject, what I'm waiting for and how many days it has been. For each, write a short, friendly nudge and save it as a draft. Don't send anything: I'll read the drafts and send them myself. Leave out newsletters, automatic mail and threads I already chased in the last {{days}} days. If nothing is waiting, say so in one line.
